cases.expected: NullPointerException
cases.description: Calling findRecords with a null Name should throw a NullPointerException because the method ultimately forwards the argument to lookup which expects a non‑null name.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException
cases.description: Passing an invalid DNS type (negative value) should cause lookup to reject the request and throw an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status SUCCESS and an RRset containing the A record for www.example.com.
cases.description: The zone contains an A record for www.example.com. The query should return a successful SetResponse with the exact matching RRset.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status NXDOMAIN
cases.description: The queried name does not exist in the zone at all, so lookup should return an NXDOMAIN response.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status NODATA (name exists but no SRV RRset)
cases.description: The name host.example.com exists (e.g., has an A record) but there is no SRV record. The method should return a NODATA response.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status DELEGATION and the NS RRset for sub.example.com.
cases.description: sub.example.com is a delegated sub‑zone (has NS records). The lookup should identify the delegation and return a DELEGATION response.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status CNAME and the CNAME RRset pointing to the canonical name.
cases.description: alias.example.com is defined as a CNAME record. The query for an A record should result in a CNAME response containing the CNAME RRset.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status SUCCESS and an RRset derived from the wildcard *.example.com A record.
cases.description: The zone contains a wildcard A record (*.example.com). A query for a name that does not have an explicit record should be satisfied by the wildcard, returning a SUCCESS response.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status NXDOMAIN
cases.description: When the Zone instance contains no records, any lookup should result in an NXDOMAIN response.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status SUCCESS and an RRset containing the SOA record for the zone apex.
cases.description: Querying the zone origin for its SOA should return a successful response with the SOA RRset.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status SUCCESS and an RRset containing the NS records for the zone apex.
cases.description: The apex NS records are present; a lookup for NS at the zone origin must return them.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status NODATA (name exists but no A RRset at the apex).
cases.description: The zone origin exists but does not have an A record; the lookup should indicate NODATA.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status SUCCESS and RRsets for all record types (e.g., A, AAAA, MX) associated with multirec.example.com.
cases.description: An ANY query should return every RRset stored for the name, confirming aggregation logic.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status NXDOMAIN
cases.description: ANY query for a name that is not present in the zone must result in NXDOMAIN.

group: findRecords - CNAME chain and loop handling

cases.expected: SetResponse with status CNAME and RRsets containing the CNAME chain (alias1 → alias2 → target.example.com) plus the final A record for target.example.com.
cases.description: When a CNAME chain resolves to a concrete record, the response should include the CNAME(s) and the terminal A RRset.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException (or SERVFAIL) indicating a CNAME loop was detected.
cases.description: A CNAME loop (loop1 → loop2 → loop1) must be detected and cause a failure rather than infinite recursion.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status DNAME and an RRset containing the DNAME record for example.com pointing to newexample.com, plus synthesized CNAME(s) for host.example.com.
cases.description: A DNAME at example.com should cause the lookup to return a DNAME response with appropriate synthesized CNAMEs for the queried name.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status SUCCESS and the same A RRset as a lower‑case query (Name.fromString("www.example.com.")).
cases.description: DNS name matching must be case‑insensitive; the result should be identical to the lower‑case form.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status SUCCESS and an RRset containing the DS records for the delegated sub‑zone.
cases.description: When a child zone is delegated, its DS records are stored at the parent; a DS query for the child should return those records.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status SUCCESS and an RRset containing the root zone NS records.
cases.description: A lookup for NS at the root name (".") must return the root NS RRset.

cases.expected: SetResponse with status NODATA (root name exists but has no A record).
cases.description: The root zone does not have an A record; the lookup should indicate NODATA.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException
cases.description: DNS type 0 is reserved and not a valid query type; lookup should reject it and throw IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException
cases.description: Type values larger than the 16‑bit DNS type space (65535) are illegal; the method should throw IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException
cases.description: A Name that does not end with the root label (i.e., not absolute) is invalid for zone lookups; lookup should throw IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException
cases.description: An empty Name (zero labels) cannot be looked up in a zone; the method should reject it with IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException
cases.description: If a Zone instance is created without setting an origin (e.g., using the default constructor and never calling setOrigin), internal lookup will fail and should throw IllegalStateException.
